title: Stop the workflow from publishing broken code
prompt: This GitHub Actions workflow is meant to publish `@northwind/ui` to npm after changes are merged and tested. As written, it can put untested, unreviewed code in front of all 40 teams. Select the line or lines that cause that.
hints: When does this workflow run? Has the code been reviewed and merged at that point?
Read the steps top to bottom: what happens if the build or the visual tests fail?
explanation:
Two lines are wrong.

- **Line 3** triggers the workflow on `pull_request`, so every open pull request publishes, before review or merge. A release workflow should run on `push` to `main`.
- **Line 18** publishes right after installing, before `npm run build`, `npm test` and the visual tests. If any of those fail, the package is already on npm. Publishing must be the last step.

The fix: `on: push: branches: [main]`, and move the publish step (or the Changesets action that runs it) after build, tests and visual tests.
